lines.speaker: LAB TECHNICIAN
lines.text: Stop. Nobody touches this envelope until all four seals are read aloud.
lines.sfx_cue: sealed envelope slapped onto wooden table

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Read Kesar’s result first. I have waited long enough for everyone else’s name.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: And read mine in front of my children. They buried my name in public.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Both results will be read. Nobody leaves midway.

lines.speaker: LAB TECHNICIAN
lines.text: Seal one, district forensic laboratory. Seal two, collection officer. Seal three, magistrate’s court. Seal four, receiving clerk.
lines.sfx_cue: wax seals tapped one by one

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The samples were not mixed? I need that stated clearly.

lines.speaker: LAB TECHNICIAN
lines.text: They were collected separately, coded separately and tested twice.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Then open it.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Ma, hold my hand.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I am holding it.

lines.speaker: LAB TECHNICIAN
lines.text: Reference sample A belongs to Devraj. Reference sample B belongs to the woman identifying herself as Meera.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: She is Meera. You may read the report exactly, but she is my daughter.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Let the paper say it too.

lines.speaker: LAB TECHNICIAN
lines.text: The probability of biological parentage between sample A and sample B exceeds ninety-nine point nine nine percent.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: What does that mean? Say it normally.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: It means the laboratory confirms that Meera is Devraj’s biological daughter.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Say her full status too. She is alive.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Meera is alive, and this report scientifically confirms her identity.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I called my own daughter an impostor. This paper does not remove that shame.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: No. It does not.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: But it removes the excuse of anyone who still calls you a stranger.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CORRIDOR
lines.text: The dead woman’s sample is next.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Do not call her that. Call her Kesar, if the report gives me that right.

lines.speaker: LAB TECHNICIAN
lines.text: The second comparison uses preserved tissue from the burned body and Janki’s reference sample.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Her black thread had three knots. There was a copper bead between the second and third.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Those details supported the inquiry. DNA will decide the identification.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: I know. I am only... I am trying to remember her before you read it.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Remember her.

lines.speaker: LAB TECHNICIAN
lines.text: The preserved tissue is not genetically related to Devraj.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Then the woman I signed for was never my daughter.

lines.speaker: LAB TECHNICIAN
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: And me? Please, do not stop there.

lines.speaker: LAB TECHNICIAN
lines.text: The sibling analysis supports a full biological sister relationship between Janki and the deceased woman.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: How strongly? Give me the number.

lines.speaker: LAB TECHNICIAN
lines.text: The likelihood ratio exceeds twenty-eight thousand to one.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: So she was Kesar.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Yes. The woman cremated under Meera’s name was Kesar.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: They searched for Meera’s killers while my sister lay inside Meera’s death certificate.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: And while I was alive inside another woman’s name.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Mother, does this finish it? Can nobody take you away now?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: It finishes who I am. It does not finish what was done.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Correct. Identity is settled. Criminal responsibility is not.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: I want Kesar’s name returned today.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The civil registrar has been directed to prepare the corrected certificate.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Directed is not delivered.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Then we will collect it ourselves.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One hour later, the laboratory report reached the district records counter before anyone could soften its language.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: I need the original death entry, the disputed seal order and both certified DNA pages.
lines.sfx_cue: rubber stamps knocking in a drawer

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: You already have them.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: I have copies. Today, copies are not enough.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: They were enough when the office declared me dead.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Yes. That was wrong.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Say the exact wrong.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The burned body was registered under Meera’s name without scientific identification.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: And I signed the identification.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: You did.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: After Meera’s name was already written on the form.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Which officer entered that name, Babulal? Promise nothing. Read the movement sheet.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The receiving duty officer wrote it. The entry says, identity supplied by telephone before family arrival.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Whose telephone call?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The caller field contains one name.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Read it.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Raghav.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: He gave them Meera’s name before I saw the body?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Twenty-three minutes before you signed.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then my father did not begin the lie.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I still completed it.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The duty officer physically wrote Meera’s name. The record says Raghav supplied it by telephone.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: He named my sister as Meera before anyone had identified her.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: That is what the contemporaneous entry records.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: There is another attachment. The east depot complaint mentioned in the Kota register inquiry.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: The second woman.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Read only what the document establishes.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The complaint identifies the missing woman as Kesar. A depot camera note records Raghav’s former vehicle number.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Kesar was the second woman linked to that alleged buyer?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Yes. The complaint gives her name, the vehicle number and the east depot location.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: His vehicle arrived with three occupants and left with two.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The depot timing places Kesar outside that vehicle before it departed Kota.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: He left her there.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The records show his vehicle departed after Kesar was dropped near the east depot. They do not yet prove what happened after that.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: But they prove why the third occupant was missing when the vehicle left.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Yes. Kesar was the third occupant. Raghav’s vehicle left with two after leaving her behind.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: And later she was found at the accident site under Meera’s name.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The DNA report establishes that the burned body at that site was Kesar.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: I can now cancel the incorrect body-name entry and create Kesar’s lawful death record.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Do it where I can see your hand.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Cause and criminal responsibility remain subject to investigation. Identity is confirmed by DNA.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Write her name without Meera’s name beside it.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Kesar. Female. Identity confirmed.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Again.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Kesar.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: She waited inside my grave. I waited outside my house.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Neither of you chose that.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The corrected certificate is ready.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Give it to me.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: This certifies the death under Kesar’s own name. The previous certificate naming Meera remains suspended for cancellation by the court.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: For the first time since she vanished, an office has written my sister’s name correctly.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: And Mother’s name?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Tomorrow, the court will hear the DNA report, the money trail and the false identification entry together.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Will the four men come too?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Yes. The court has ordered all four produced.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then let everyone who saw four murderers see four living men.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: And everyone who saw a stranger will see my daughter.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: What does the final laboratory conclusion say? Not the certificate. The last paragraph.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: It says the remains match Janki’s biological family and do not match Devraj’s family.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Read the consequence.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The DNA report places Kesar at the accident site and Meera nowhere near the death scene.

lines.speaker: COURT OFFICER
lines.text: Remove their handcuffs. The murder charge has just lost its dead woman.
lines.sfx_cue: courtroom handcuff chain dropping onto rail

lines.speaker: naresh
lines.text: Do not say that unless the judge has signed it.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: We want the order. All four names. Read every name.

lines.speaker: COURT OFFICER
lines.text: Stand quietly. The court is sitting.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: This is the reopened matter concerning Meera’s identity, Kesar’s remains and the prosecution of four accused men.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I request permission to stand with my children.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: Granted.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Ma, they really took the chains off.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Not all of them. Their ankles are still locked.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: Court officer, remove every restraint unless you have a separate lawful warrant.

lines.speaker: COURT OFFICER
lines.text: There is no separate warrant.

lines.speaker: pintu
lines.text: Then use the key.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: Wait... wait until the order. We have been promised doors before.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: He is right. Read it first.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: The DNA report confirms that Meera is alive and identifies the burned remains as Kesar.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: The factual basis for alleging that these four men murdered Meera no longer exists.

lines.speaker: naresh
lines.text: Then we leave today?

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: You will hear the full order without interruption.

lines.speaker: naresh
lines.text: Yes, Your Honour.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: The prosecution relied upon a body identification now disproved by DNA, a missing statement and inconsistent case records.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: No lawful purpose is served by preserving a murder case for a person who stands alive before this court.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN GALLERY
lines.text: They spent all that time in jail for nothing.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Say it louder. The village called us murderers louder than that.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: Silence in court.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: The murder proceedings against Salim, Naresh, Pintu and Irfan are quashed.

lines.speaker: pintu
lines.text: Quashed means finished? Not bail?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Finished. The murder case cannot keep you in custody.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: All four of us?

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: All four.

lines.speaker: naresh
lines.text: No reporting every week? No police permission to leave Dharmapur?

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: Not under this quashed case.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: And my missing five-page statement?

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: Its disappearance will remain part of the departmental and criminal inquiry.

lines.speaker: pintu
lines.text: We entered this building as four murderers.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Then let the officer say how we leave.

lines.speaker: COURT OFFICER
lines.text: You leave as free men. There is no subsisting custody order against any of you.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN GALLERY
lines.text: Salim and the others are innocent of Meera’s murder.

lines.speaker: naresh
lines.text: There was no murder of Meera.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I am sorry my stolen name became your prison.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: You came back alive. You did not put us there.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: Will my brother receive protection now? I gave the court what I knew.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The protection direction remains active. Your release does not cancel it.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: Good. Then open the gate.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: Before release processing, the court will address the remaining evidence concerning Raghav.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I came voluntarily. I have answered every proper question.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: You changed your Kota statement after the travel register was requested.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I corrected an error. Correction is not concealment.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Your former vehicle entered Kota with three occupants and left with two.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: A vehicle number does not identify passengers.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The east depot record identifies Kesar as the third occupant left near the depot.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: That is an interpretation.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The DNA report identifies Kesar as the woman later found burned at the accident site.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: DNA cannot place me at an accident I did not witness.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: The court has not said it can.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Then there is no ground to detain me.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: There is also the five-lakh-rupee deposit made two days before Meera disappeared.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: A tractor payment.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: No tractor was registered. No purchase invoice exists. No delivery occurred.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Registration can be delayed.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: For eighteen months?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: The buyer may have abandoned the transaction.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Then why was the money never returned?

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Ask the account holder.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: We did. Your cousin states that you controlled the passbook and withdrawal slips.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: He is protecting himself.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The first withdrawal occurred forty minutes after your vehicle entered Kota.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Coincidence is still legal.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You knew the five-lakh date before I said the amount.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: You have repeated that performance enough.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Do not call my mother a performance.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN GALLERY
lines.text: He called her an impostor too.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: No. I called her that. I was wrong, and I said so before this village.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Raghav supplied her name for the burned body before I reached the hospital.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: You signed the form, Devraj. Be careful where you move your shame.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I am not moving it. I am naming the man who placed the lie in front of me.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: The movement sheet records that a duty officer wrote Meera’s name after receiving it by telephone from Raghav.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: That entry proves only that someone used my name.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The call originated from the number registered to your transport office.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Many people used that office.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: You may contest the evidence during investigation and trial. Today, the court considers preservation of evidence and risk of interference.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I have remained in Dharmapur throughout.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: You filed a changed statement, denied Kota and described the travel register as fabricated.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The register predates this inquiry. Its paper, ink and binding were verified.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: A clerk defending a neglected register is not an expert.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: No. The forensic document examiner is.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: The application for custodial arrest is allowed concerning the money trail, false identification information and connected disappearance inquiry.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: On suspicion?

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: On recorded financial evidence, contradictory statements and a documented risk of interference.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Meera’s allegation remains an allegation.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: And it will be investigated as one. Turn around.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: You are arresting the man who brought her to safety.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You brought me to Kota. You did not bring me home.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: This village will tire of your story.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Your hands, please. The court has been courteous enough to provide an order.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN GALLERY
lines.text: Raghav is leaving in chains while the four men walk free.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Look at me, Raghav.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: I do not take instructions from you.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: You sent us to that road. Your name stayed outside the file. Ours went inside a murder charge.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Then enjoy your release carefully. Dharmapur has a long memory.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: So does a recorded threat made inside a courtroom.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: It was advice.

lines.speaker: JUDGE
lines.text: Remove him.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: Meera, this does not prove your entire story.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: No. It proves enough to stop you walking away today.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By noon, the hearing moved from the courtroom to the public records desk, where the first wrong had been written.
lines.sfx_cue: large register dropped onto public counter

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The court order directs immediate cancellation of Meera’s death entry.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Not another disputed stamp. Cancellation.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Cancellation. The red line will cross the full entry, and the order number will be written beside it.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Let us see every word.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Can I stand on the chair? I cannot see.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Come here. I will lift you.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: And Kesar’s certificate?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Entered under her own name, with the DNA confirmation attached.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Show the seal.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Here.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Kesar. Not unidentified. Not Meera.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Kesar.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The same villagers watched me refuse my daughter’s hand.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: We watched.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Then watch this too.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Meera is my daughter. I identified the wrong body, and I was wrong to call her a stranger.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Father.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I will not ask you to erase what I did.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Good. Stand beside me while they erase what the register did.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Our release orders are stamped.

lines.speaker: naresh
lines.text: Four orders. I counted twice.

lines.speaker: pintu
lines.text: The outside gate is open.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: My brother is waiting beyond it.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Walk through together. The crowd must see all four of you leave without restraints.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Meera, come with us to the gate.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: First, I need to watch my death end.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Red line through the old entry.
lines.sfx_cue: pen dragging slowly across register page

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: It is gone?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Legally cancelled.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Write the new entry clearly.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The court has supplied the final wording.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: Read it before you write.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: One living person restored. One deceased person correctly identified. Four accused released from a case without a murdered Meera.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Write it.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: Make room. Let all four men reach the gate.

lines.speaker: naresh
lines.text: No chains.

lines.speaker: pintu
lines.text: No guards holding our arms.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: No murder case behind us.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Ma, they are free.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: And you are not dead.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Not in this house. Not in this village. Not on that page.

lines.speaker: janki
lines.text: My sister has her name.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: My daughter has hers.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Final entry complete. I will read it exactly once.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The official register now records one final fact: Meera is alive, Kesar was the woman cremated, and all four accused are free.

beat_sheet.what_happened: The sealed DNA report was dispatched before its results were read to any cast character.

state_changes.fact: The sealed identity findings became ready for official delivery.

beat_sheet.note: Deliberate open-canon beat: the dispatch occurred in an empty records room, so no cast character witnessed the contents before the formal reading.

beat_sheet.location: district forensic laboratory public reading room
beat_sheet.what_happened: The DNA report confirmed that Meera is Devraj's biological daughter and that the burned woman was Janki's biological sister Kesar.

state_changes.fact: Her identity as Devraj's living biological daughter was scientifically confirmed.
She received scientific confirmation that the burned woman was Kesar.
The burned remains were identified as Kesar rather than Meera.

beat_sheet.what_happened: The records established that a duty officer wrote Meera's name on the body form after Raghav supplied that identity by telephone, and that Kesar was the third occupant left near the east depot before Raghav's vehicle departed Kota with two people.

state_changes.fact: The records connected him to the premature naming of the burned body and to Kesar's departure from his vehicle.
The source and writer of Meera's prematurely entered name were identified.
Kesar was identified as the second woman linked to an alleged buyer and the missing third vehicle occupant.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Babulal issued Janki a death certificate under Kesar's name, and Kavita read that the DNA placed Kesar at the accident site and excluded Meera from it.

state_changes.fact: She received her sister's death certificate under Kesar's correct name.
The DNA excluded her from the death scene.
The death was officially recorded under Kesar's name.

beat_sheet.what_happened: The court quashed the murder proceedings against Salim, Naresh, Pintu and Irfan because Meera was alive and the body was Kesar's, and ordered all four released without restraints.

state_changes.fact: The murder case against him was quashed and he was freed.
The murder case against him was quashed and he was freed.
The murder case against him was quashed and he was freed.
The murder case against him was quashed and he was freed.

state_changes.fact: He was arrested for investigation concerning the money trail, false identification information and connected disappearance evidence.
Raghav could no longer leave the inquiry without answering the documented evidence.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Devraj repeated his public recognition of Meera, Janki displayed Kesar's corrected certificate and Babulal cancelled Meera's death entry while the four freed men walked out without restraints.

state_changes.fact: Her death record was formally cancelled before her family and the village.
He publicly reaffirmed that Meera is his daughter and that his identification was wrong.
Kesar's identity was publicly restored under her own certificate.

beat_sheet.what_happened: The official register recorded that Meera was alive, Kesar was the woman cremated and all four accused were free.

state_changes.fact: It now records Meera alive, Kesar correctly identified and all four accused free.
Her legal status was restored to living.
The cremated woman was permanently recorded as Kesar.

promise_ledger.listener_is_waiting_for: Whose body was cremated after being wrongly identified as Meera?
promise_ledger.how_paid: DNA testing identified the burned woman as Janki's missing sister Kesar, and Janki received a death certificate under Kesar's name.

promise_ledger.listener_is_waiting_for: Does the matching hospital number prove that the burned woman was Kesar?
promise_ledger.how_paid: A sibling DNA comparison scientifically confirmed that the burned remains belonged to Kesar.

promise_ledger.listener_is_waiting_for: Who wrote Meera's name on the unidentified-body form before Devraj signed the identification?
promise_ledger.how_paid: The movement sheet showed that the receiving duty officer wrote Meera's name after Raghav supplied that identity by telephone twenty-three minutes before Devraj signed.

promise_ledger.listener_is_waiting_for: Who was the second person linked to an alleged buyer, and why did Raghav's vehicle leave Kota on the night that person disappeared?
promise_ledger.how_paid: The east depot complaint and vehicle records identified Kesar as the second woman and third occupant; Raghav's vehicle departed with two people after leaving her near the depot.

dates_fixed.what: Meera enters Dharmapur police station and discovers that she remains recorded as dead.
Kavita conducts the initial private identity test and finds the tattoo-hand discrepancy.
Meera visits her former house under police guard and the bus stand photograph arrives.
Raghav gives his account before the village committee and reveals knowledge of a payment dated 2021-05-03.
Meera identifies room twelve in Kota, Mohan publicly calls her Ma and the rental ledger reveals a disputed signature dated 2021-06-21.
Kavita conducts the open identity verification and Meera's death certificate is marked disputed.
The four jailed accused appear in court, Salim implicates Raghav and his indexed statement is found missing from the case diary.
The court brings the four accused into the reopened inquiry, and Janki links Kesar's complaint to the burned body's hospital intake number.
Devraj admits that fear and grief caused the mistaken identification and publicly recognises Meera as his daughter.
Kavita traces the five-lakh-rupee deposit dated 2021-05-03 and finds no registered tractor corresponding to Raghav's explanation.
Tara tests Meera with the buried clay bird, publicly accepts her as her mother and allows her to sleep in the family house.
Raghav withdraws his Kota account and Babulal produces the unclosed travel-register entry for Raghav's vehicle.
DNA confirms Meera's identity and identifies the burned woman as Kesar, whose corrected death certificate is issued.
The four accused are freed, Raghav is arrested, Meera's death record is cancelled and the final register entry restores every identity.

periods_fixed.elapsed: No time elapsed; both episodes occur on 2022-11-14.
